entries.zh: 矿；矿藏、矿山（采掘矿物之处）
entries.en: mine; ore, mineral deposit

entries.zh: 金山（产金之山）；皇家矿场（mina real）
entries.en: royal mine; gold mountain, gold mine

entries.zh: 铜山（产铜之山）；矿之通称（mina general）
entries.en: copper mountain; mine in general
entries.notes: M 栏音写多出 gûn coān 两音节，与汉字数不合；释义以 L/H 两栏为准。

entries.zh: 滚地龙（字面义；具体所指与西语 Ministraría 之对应未明，释义存疑）
entries.en: lit. 'rolling ground dragon': sense undetermined; cf. Sp. ministraría (office or fee pertaining to a minister)
entries.notes: M 栏中间音节 T99 污损难辨，且中西两栏语义对应不明，释义存疑。

entries.zh: 属下，部下；受差遣供役使之人
entries.en: subordinate, one under another's authority; servant, retainer

entries.zh: 手下，麾下人员；差役、办事人员
entries.en: those under one's command, subordinates; officials, functionaries

entries.zh: 役，衙役、差役（执掌司法之吏役）
entries.en: minister of justice; bailiff, constable, officer of the law
entries.notes: M 栏音写含 T99 污损；释义据 H「役」与 L「ministro de justicia」互证，音写判读存疑。

entries.zh: 牌头（保甲十户之长，充当地方司法差役）
entries.en: head of a tithing/ward unit serving as local constable (ministro de justicia)

entries.zh: 省察，省视；察验（自我审察以求确证）
entries.en: to examine (oneself), inspect; to look at attentively

entries.zh: 观，观看；观察
entries.en: to look at, observe, behold
entries.notes: M 栏第三音节 T99 污损难辨，低置信据此标记。

entries.zh: 视，看、观看
entries.en: to look at, see, view

entries.zh: 见，看见
entries.en: to see; to look at, catch sight of

entries.zh: 睛（目珠）；谓目不转睛、凝神直视（据西语习语 mirar de hito en hito）
entries.en: to stare fixedly (mirar de hito en hito); lit. eyeball
entries.notes: 汉字「睛」本义为眼珠，与西语习语「凝视」对应欠直接，或涉形近字之辨；M 栏音写附分写标注，判读依赖推断。

entries.zh: 望，远望；盼望、有所期待而望
entries.en: to gaze into the distance; to look expecting, to hope for

entries.zh: 瞻，瞻望（仰首前望，心有所待）；倚望
entries.en: to gaze forward/upward expectantly; to look awaiting
entries.notes: 西语词头「el g」为未展开缩写（疑为 el que），展开依赖推断。

entries.zh: 览，观览、阅览（书卷）
entries.en: to view, peruse, read over (a book)

entries.zh: 照，照耀；映照、照影（借光反照而观）
entries.en: to shine, illuminate; to reflect, to look by reflected light; reflected image

entries.zh: 相，观看、端详；相看（彼此相视）
entries.en: to look at, view; to observe one another

entries.zh: 省见，察看；看见
entries.en: to look at and see; to observe

entries.zh: 观省，观看省察；观察
entries.en: to observe and examine; to look attentively

entries.zh: 赌，赌博、下注
entries.en: to gamble, bet, stake
entries.notes: 西语词头「mirar generos Lad~」残缺（Lad~ 未展开），中西对应不明；中义据 H「賭」与 M 音写定为赌博。
